0.title: What exactly is a LifeGroup?

00.title: How do I join a LifeGroup?
00.content:
First, give yourself a high five for taking the step to join a LifeGroup! Here are several easy ways to get connected:

  • Visit the Get Connected area at any of our Life.Church locations and talk to the staff or volunteers there. If you attend Life.Church Online, talk to the volunteers in the chat area or contact the team here.
  • Find a LifeGroup near you or one that meets digitally using our online LifeGroups search tool.
  • Talk to someone you know who leads a LifeGroup and ask if their group is open to new members.

Find a LifeGroup

01.content:
Every LifeGroup is unique. Some discuss the weekend message or content like the You’ve Heard It Said podcast, some complete Bible Plans in the YouVersion Bible App together, some serve together in the community, and some play board games or skateboard once a month. Two things you’ll find in every LifeGroup, though, are relationships and conversations that help people grow in their faith.

Find a LifeGroup
01.title: What do you actually do in a LifeGroup?

02.content:
Absolutely! It’s understandable to want to find people you feel comfortable opening up to and developing friendships with. That being said, if you’ve joined a LifeGroup and aren’t sure if it’s the right fit for you, don’t give up. Keep in mind that there’s no such thing as a perfect LifeGroup because there are no perfect people. Remember to have grace and patience during the process. If it’s clear that this group isn’t the best fit for you, though, give another group a try.

Find a LifeGroup
02.title: Is it okay to “shop around” for a LifeGroup?

03.title: What if there’s not a LifeGroup for what I’m looking for?
03.content:
This might be a sign that God is calling you to start a group! If God’s placed a certain passion or calling within you, He might want you to take a step of faith and launch a LifeGroup around it. You won’t have to do this alone, though. Your Community Team is here to support you every step of the way.

Volunteer Application

04.title: How do I start my own LifeGroup?
04.content:
First, fill out our Volunteer Application. After that, your Community Team will reach out to help you prepare to lead your group. Then, you can invite people to your group and start meeting!

Volunteer Application

05.title: What if I don’t feel qualified to be a LifeGroup Leader?
05.content:
Don’t worry—you don’t have to a Bible scholar to lead a LifeGroup! We have lots of great resources to make leading a group as easy as possible, including conversation topics for your group, content to go through, tips for new leaders, and resources to help you develop and grow as a leader. You’ll also be connected to a LifeGroups Coach, who will be there to support you with prayer, resources, and encouragement along the way.

Resources for Leaders

06.title: What if I have any other questions about LifeGroups?
06.content:
We’re here to help! If you attend a Life.Church location, connect with your Community Team or talk with a volunteer at the Get Connected area on the weekend. If you attend Life.Church Online or don’t live near a physical location, connect with the Life.Church Online team.

Ask a Question
